issues.what: Timeline hole: the sea is three days' walk (ch2, ch3), yet on day 9 the family walks there in one morning, and the uncles are at home on days 6-9, so they could never have reached the shore to kill Žilvinas
issues.quote: Eglė walked three days from the lake to the sea

issues.what: Names lose their Lithuanian diacritics from ch4 on (Azuolas, Berzas, Drebule) after ch1-3 spell them correctly
issues.quote: The eldest uncle looked at Azuolas.

issues.what: The youngest uncle is beardless in ch3-4, then has a thin yellow beard that brushes her cheek
issues.quote: His beard was thin and yellow.

issues.what: Christian crossing oneself in pagan Lithuania (ch1 and ch3)
issues.quote: The mother crossed herself after the old way

issues.what: Žilvinas suddenly has a staff; in ch2 he parts the sea with spoken words
issues.quote: He lifted his staff and the sea stood up

issues.what: Tense slip and a garbled fragment
issues.quote: He is not yet bearded but his smile made room for you.

issues.what: Titles do not match content: ch5 'The Sauna Door' happens in the alder hollow; ch6 'The Amber Bead' is the red foam; ch3 'The Calling Words' is the homecoming
issues.quote: The Sauna Door

issues.what: Born in the sixth of nine years, Drebulė is about three at the visit (brief says nine); her voice reads older. Left as is
issues.quote: In the sixth year I was born.

issues.what: The youngest of twelve sisters kisses 'twelve' sisters
issues.quote: twelve kisses, salt on her lips

fix: Ch2-3: make the sea one long day's walk; ch6: send the uncles away on day 6 and back with sea sand on their feet; ch4-6: restore diacritics; ch5: keep the uncle beardless; ch1/ch3: replace crossing with a pagan gesture; ch3: words not staff; retitle ch3-6.
praise: A true and tender telling of Eglė: the three woods tried one by one, the amber bead and the wren, and a mother's judgement that is terrible and kind in the same breath.

issues.what: Opens by retelling ch1 as if new (knock, birth, bread, bridge, crowing), and the replay contradicts it: she crows in Peio's henhouse across the flood, Andere is the mother
issues.quote: Once there was a midwife waked at midnight, and if you had been there

issues.what: Andere says her time is upon her, but ch1 has her sister give birth; ch2-3 then call the baby Andere's daughter
issues.quote: Not Andere Urgorri who had knocked, but her sister

issues.what: Duplicate chapter title: ch1 and ch3 are both 'The River Cave'
issues.quote: The River Cave

issues.what: The false crow is 'an hour before dawn', yet after hours of labour true dawn is still an hour away
issues.quote: in the rain, an hour before dawn

issues.what: Peio says his mother is with Maialen; the scene then has Maialen's mother
issues.quote: My mother is with her.

issues.what: Basket was tied to her arm yet a lamia set it on the bank; lantern left with Andere then reappears
issues.quote: taking back her basket from where Andere's sister had set it

issues.what: Typo 'Laminas'; 'Gau on' glossed as good evening; coins 'sewn' though slipped loose in ch1; wheaten bread was rye
issues.quote: Laminas do not shriek like market wives.

issues.what: Ch3 drops quotation marks that ch1-2 use. Left as is
issues.quote: Peio, she said. You spoke quick.

fix: Ch3: cut the replay down to a one-line opener and retitle; ch1: Andere is the labouring lamia, sister serves the bread; fix crow timing, Maialen's mother, basket and lantern, coins, rye, typos; retitle ch2.
praise: A sly, neighbourly Basque tale whose second trick (lantern light on a cock's feathers) tops the first, and whose midwife stays dry and brave to the last line.

issues.what: Rewritten ch4 now continues cleanly from the ch3 call, with 59 planks at the factory and the thin one only in Rosaria's kerchief. Small slips: Tiago never mentioned brakes at a crossing
issues.quote: The brakes at the crossing.

issues.what: Planks said to carry an 'estate mark', never set up; the clue is the painted year digit
issues.quote: The outer faces bore the estate mark.

issues.what: Henrique says he sent the creditor an 'estimate request'; in ch3 the estimate went to the factory
issues.quote: I sent an estimate request

issues.what: Repeats ch2's 'knees cracking' and 'sixty wounds drying in the sun', and counts the rows twice
issues.quote: Sixty wounds drying in the sun.

issues.what: Leitao is at the estate but 'answered the phone on speaker' as if in the room
issues.quote: Old Leitao answered the phone on speaker

praise: The rewrite pays off the thin-plank clue on the factory scale beside fifty-nine thick ones, and the unopened tobacco tin finally opening is a quiet, earned ending.
